attack_shape_verbatim: Merge two curative alternates into one unexplained pick in a copy and attack whether the check fires; hunt for an evidence-indistinguishable pair shipped without a discriminating experiment.
claim_under_attack: The current CF-ALT deliverable state is complete and accurate for its scope (finding a miss is CLAIM_REFUTED and is progress).
refutation_criterion_verbatim: Any pair of evidence-indistinguishable candidates ships without ranked alternates and a named discriminating experiment.

step_2_named_discriminating_experiments_.finding: The only named discriminating experiment in the corpus (key_pairwise: Enhanced-65 > Envelope-65) is keyed to the Lineage-60/Envelope-65/Enhanced-65/CRO-Robust-65 track namespace, not to the M00-series ids this module's own capture_template.json carries. Only M00097 has a prose (not structured/machine-checkable) tie to a track name ('Lead M00097 / Envelope-65' in blueprint.md). M00101 and M00109 -- both explicitly in THIS module's own 'candidates' list -- are never tied to any track name anywhere in the four in-scope files, so the named experiment cannot be verified to resolve them. Separately, 'Enhanced-65' (the zinc-phosphate functional variant per blueprint prose) most plausibly corresponds to M00098, which is entirely ABSENT from this module's own candidates list and prediction_ledger -- an internal inconsistency in this module's own carried-candidate bookkeeping, independent of the cross-module ownership question.
